note: סינ is the consonantal base of the gentilic. Its verbal etymology is unknown.
summary: סִינִי designates a member of the Sinite clan among Canaan’s descendants. In the genealogy the definite singular names the clan as a whole.

senses.definition: A member of the Sinite clan among Canaan’s descendants. The definite singular can designate the clan collectively.

evidence.note: הַסִּינִי follows the Hivite and the Arkite in a list identified as the clans of the Canaanites.
The parallel genealogy lists the Sinite after the Hivite and the Arkite.
